# Service-calendar headway fixtures

Small GTFS Schedule ZIPs for `tests/headway_calendar.rs`. They were taken from the
2026-11-26 service-calendar audit and generated by `generate.py`. The original
audit evidence remains outside this repository at
`~/GTFS/calendar-audit-evidence/`.

To regenerate in isolation, run:

```sh
python3 generate.py /tmp/gtfs-headway-calendar-fixtures
```

Only the fixtures exercised by the integration test are checked in. The generator
also creates audit scenarios for OPR_005 and other rules; those files are not
included here until their respective implementation stages.
